stations.name: NDBC 51201 Waimea Bay, HI (CDIP 106)
stations.position_source: NDBC activestations.xml (created 2026-10-12T09:55:13UTC); current deployment since 2023-08-04 (NDBC stationmetadata.xml). Water depth: 200 m (NDBC station page; CDIP 106p1 metaWaterDepth 200.0)
stations.attribution: NOAA National Data Buoy Center (NDBC). US Government data, public domain (https://www.ndbc.noaa.gov/). Wave data from the Coastal Data Information Program (CDIP), Scripps Institution of Oceanography, UCSD, relayed by NDBC; CDIP's realtime files state: "These data may be redistributed and used without restriction." Acknowledgment from the CDIP file (106p1_rt.nc): "CDIP is primarily supported by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE). Station partner: PACIOOS ; Field operator: PACIOOS/UH"
stations.operator: Pacific Islands Ocean Observing System (PacIOOS); CDIP station 106
stations.platform: Datawell DWR-M3 directional Waverider (CDIP 106p1 summary attribute)
stations.apd_kind_source: CDIP buoy: APD = m0/m1 (NDBC wavecalc.shtml: 'Average periods (APD) for Scripps's buoys are derived from the zeroth moment divided by the first moment'); live check 2026-10-12: NDBC APD = CDIP waveTa within 0.005 s on 881 reports
stations.measured: WVHT (spectral Hm0), DPD (Tp), APD (Tm01), MWD (peak direction FROM), no wind; swell / wind-sea split (.spec, realtime only)
stations.bulletin_note: WW3 depth at the output point 472.7 m (gfswave.51201.spec point line, 2026-10-11 00Z) against 200 m at the mooring.

paired_spots.note: CDIP Waverider in 200 m off Waimea Bay, 6.7 km from the break, in the same NW-N exposure as the North Shore reefs (the buoy bears W (275 deg) from the break). It measures the offshore swell before the reefs refract and focus it (cf. Caldwell & Aucan 2007), so its Hs is an offshore reference, not surf height. At 200 m long-period swell (20 s, deep-water wavelength 625 m) is already slightly in intermediate depth.
